comments.body_html: Does this mod support adding modded items? I have a mod that adds full auto receivers of various weapons, however without me doing custom presets and trader assorts the receiver is the only item able to be purchased. comments.author: GoatBoy
comments.body_html: Yes, any modded item from any mod should show up if you search for it when adding an item to a trader, if it doesn’t show up, let me know and I’ll look into it. You should also be able to search the mod’s name and the items should show up ex. WTT - Armory. You can also edit the weapons, armors, or any items that generally support attachments. If you mean make a global preset, then no. It is something that I want to include though, where weapon presets that you make in the normal edit screen show up when searching for an item to add to a trader.
